verdict.rationale: The aihero.dev/skills page is a browsable catalog of the product's 25 skills, each with a one-line description. It invites users to "pick the skills… you use" and "install the ones you want" before running the installer. The set is also listed in Claude Code's official marketplace, and there is even a skill for finding which skill fits a situation. Missing for 10: search or filtering on the catalog, any registry, leaderboard or ranking signals beyond a flat listing, and independent hands-on corroboration of the browsing experience.
